title: A Dagster asset sensor puts lineage and attribution side by side at materialisation acceptance
content:
The integration is a Dagster asset sensor dispatching a typed operation on materialisation acceptance. The framing is additive rather than corrective: lineage plus attribution, side by side. Nothing is claimed to be wrong with the lineage graph; a second question is being answered next to it.

Those questions are genuinely different. Lineage answers where a dataset came from and what it was computed from. Attribution answers who accepted the result as fit to use, and under what rule. In a pipeline where materialisation is gated on a human or policy decision, the second answer is the one an auditor or a downstream consumer needs, and it is not derivable from the dependency graph.

The single lead is Neurospace in the Aarhus area of Denmark, marked "3 · later". This is the only data-pipeline framing in this slice that leads with provenance rather than with retention — the Kestra demo, by contrast, leads with purge-and-replay.
